h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madhyamgram

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madhyamgram

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Madhyamgram

c: Madhyamgram is a busy residential town in North 24 Parganas, a short ride from Kolkata's airport, and most of its homes sit in tight lanes with little open space. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Madhyamgram for the municipality's parks, clubs, schools and apartment complexes. Our machines are made at our Vasai factory, about 1650 km away, and reach Bengal by road.

Local clubs run many of the playgrounds in towns like this, and a club committee is often the buyer. We plan each set around the ground the club already has. The other factor is water. Bengal's monsoon is long and heavy, and low plots stay soaked for days. A raised concrete base with a slight slope keeps the footings dry, and galvanised frames take the humidity well. Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs the set.

richText.heading: One frame, three exercises, for a small club ground

c: Where space is short, a combination machine saves the most room. The
Leg Press Cum Fun Walker Cum Seating Twister
puts three gentle exercises on one footing, which suits elderly members who come for a morning round. Younger members can use the

for core strength. These two machines leave the rest of the ground free for football or cricket. Place them near the club room, where members already gather, and where someone can lock the gate at night. A third machine can follow in a later year if the first two are well used.

items.q: Can a local club in Madhyamgram buy outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. Clubs, schools, apartment associations and the municipality all buy from us. The committee shares the ground size and photos, approves a layout and quote, and we manufacture and install.

items.q: How do we stop water collecting around the machines?
items.a: Build a slightly raised concrete base that slopes away from the footings. After the monsoon, clear silt and leaves and check the bolts on every machine.

items.q: Do you supply rubber flooring for outdoor gyms?
items.a: Yes. We supply rubber flooring along with our equipment. It is useful where people step on and off machines, and it gives a firmer grip on wet mornings.
